direction: Explore new priority rules for the CVRP greedy construction by changing one score term at a time.
hypothesis: Replacing one score term per round and adding a cheap second ordering stage yields better routes than rewriting the whole score at once.

operations.mechanism: Replace exactly one of the three terms (distance to the current node, distance to the depot, remaining capacity) with a different functional form and leave the other two unchanged, so the effect of the change is readable in the next round's numbers.
operations.target: one term of the priority score

operations.mechanism: After the primary score, order the candidates whose primary scores are closest together by a secondary criterion; the stage has to stay cheap enough to fit the solver budget.
Keep the capacity filter, the construction order and the sign convention of the objective unchanged.

preserve: The problem interface, the evaluator and the search policy.
